Hi Rajiv / Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Nimbus Health's inference needs. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary workload: clinical summarization + QA reranking (avg request: 1-3 prompts per patient).
- Latency SLO: 200-350ms p95 for single-turn generation at ~2k tokens/session.
- Expected peak throughput: ~120 concurrent sessions; steady-state ~35 qps.
- Data controls: VPC + customer-managed KMS required.

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with our solutions engineer to map throughput to instance types and potential autoscaling/burst configuration. Attached is a short sizing template that helps us capture sequence lengths, avg tokens per call, and concurrency assumptions ahead of the call. Filling it out is optional but speeds the session.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu 3/19 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-15:00
- Fri 3/20 09:00-10:00

If those don't work, send a couple windows or use my Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/60min

I'll loop in our SE (Dev Patel) once we lock a time.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.
